about: Bridge / flyover deck edge class per OSM way, from street-level review (appearance only; no imagery stored). Fidelity pass round 2, lane world-b, 2026-11-12; round 3, lane structures, 2026-11-13 (every remaining mapped road bridge deck of the 8 districts). Classes: parapet (solid concrete, game default), barrier (low concrete traffic barrier), kerb-railing (low kerb + steel post-and-rail), kerb-mesh (low kerb + steel posts with mesh panels), parapet-fence (concrete parapet + steel picket fence), parapet-rail (concrete parapet + steel pipe rail on top), planter (row of concrete planters at the kerb; with outer=picket-posts a picket railing on concrete posts outside the sidewalk), basarab (drawn by basarab-structure.js: blue steel rails / posts, white tubes on the river-arch span). Rows with applied=true are in game/src/bridge-guards.js (or basarab-structure.js for class basarab). evidence: 'deck' = panorama on the deck looking along its edge; 'below' = seen from a road under / beside the deck only; 'neighbour' = class of the continuous deck it belongs to; 'none' = no official panorama shows it (default kept). Districts Floreasca, Unirii and Romana have no mapped road bridge deck inside their worlds (round 3 inventory).
